verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a REST API (and even an MCP server) exposing its retrieval/synthesis capabilities, with a dedicated API page and llms-full.txt describing endpoints and features like automated searches. However, there's no evidence of detailed public API reference docs, auth/rate-limit specifics, or independent developer corroboration of usage. Missing for 10: detailed API reference/schema documentation, auth/versioning details, and third-party/hands-on confirmation of API usage.
